أتصهين (form IIq)

# أَتَصَهْيَنَ (ʔataṣahyana) /ʔa.ta.sˤah.ja.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَصَهْيَنَ (taṣahyana)
# أَتَصَهْيَنْ (ʔataṣahyan) /ʔa.ta.sˤah.jan/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَصَهْيَنَ (taṣahyana)
